title: Connected Automated Vehicles – Integrated Highway Prototype II (IHP2)
evidence: file verified and derived; ROS1 multi-vehicle field trials
source_capture: Florida tests, August 2022; catalog describes original release July 2024
rights: United States Government Public Domain License per DataCite registry
derivatives: ihp2-*.csv; researcher-derived summaries / observations; no raw ROS bags or coordinates redistributed.
limitations: Application and recorder times; uncalibrated one-way across bags. Unique matched content and callback state establishes software observation, next hardware feedback alone establishes temporal proximity.

title: Cooperative Automated Research Mobility Applications (CARMA) 2
evidence: file verified and derived; 13 vehicle platooning/merging/route verification runs
rights: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported per source Socrata license. CARMA2-derived tables in this directory distributed under same license.
attribution: U.S. Department of Transportation. (2018). Cooperative Automated Research Mobility Applications (CARMA) 2. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed 2026-11-21. https://doi.org/10.21949/1504485
derivatives: carma2-bin-quality.csv and carma2-command-audit.csv (bin cleaning, run role linkage and per-channel summaries by G1 collection).
limitations: Vehicle binaries not independently clocked; command labels not measured wheel torque. Logged roles must be consulted, worksheet nominal mode bool conflicts with observed 0/2/empty.
